composites.name: serpentinizing_vent_reactor
composites.description: A reusable alkaline-vent reactor module. Module A = genuine PHREEQC serpentinization (phreeqpython + vendored llnl.dat): olivine dissolution + serpentine/brucite/magnetite equilibrium gives dissolved H2 (reducing power), alkalinity, heat, pe, and a charge-balanced fluid. Module B = genuine FiPy finite-volume advection-diffusion-reaction column transporting those sources across the vent-ocean interface and setting outlet T/pH/porosity. PHREEQC conserves mass+charge and FiPy's FVM conserves flux, satisfying the og-00 contract invariants. Requires phreeqpython + fipy.

flow_velocity.description: Boundary water flux through the reaction zone (m/s)

olivine_rate.description: Olivine dissolution rate (mol per flow-saturated reaction step)

nx.description: FiPy finite-volume cells across the interface column

composites.name: serpentinizing_vent_reactor_reduced
composites.description: Reduced tuned-relaxation vent reactor (fallback / A-B comparison): Gaussian serpentinization source feeding a first-order relaxation box. Runs anywhere (no phreeqpython/fipy). NOT real geochemistry.

flow_velocity.description: Boundary water flux through the reaction zone (m/s)

t_target.description: Mixing-target temperature (K); Lost City mid-window ~340 K

h2_rate_max.description: Peak H2 source rate at reference flow (mol/s)

composites.name: hydrothermal_carbon_fixation
composites.description: A reusable H2/pH-driven carbon-fixation module. Module C = genuine FiPy Nernst-Planck pH-gradient electrochemistry (pmf, current density). Module D = genuine eQuilibrator ΔG' feasibility gate + lab-calibrated (Preiner/Hudson) mineral-catalyzed CO2 reduction to formate/acetate/pyruvate. gradient_efficiency=1.0 is the favorable arm; ~0.1 is the Tutolo-2026 in-situ collapse. catalyst_active/h2=0 give the controls. Requires equilibrator_api + fipy.

gradient_efficiency.description: Usable fraction of the geochemical ΔpH at in-situ T/P (1.0 favorable; ~0.1 Tutolo-2026 collapse; 0 = no-gradient control)

catalyst_active.description: Active Fe/Ni/S mineral catalyst (0 = no-catalyst control)

dilution_rate.description: Open-flow washout (1/s); 0 = closed batch (yield studies), >0 = open vent reactor → sustained-throughput regime (phase map)

config.title: Campaign I — proton gradient → reduced carbon

composites.name: protometabolic_network
composites.description: A reusable protometabolic reaction-network module. libRoadRunner/Tellurium SBML rTCA-fragment CSTR (pyruvate carboxylation + lumped autocatalytic rTCA turn + reductive branch) fed the og-01 reduced-carbon products under continuous feed+washout. Emergent: sustained carbon throughput, an autocatalytic motif (gain>1), and a connected reaction network. Requires tellurium + networkx.

feed_pyruvate.description: Pyruvate feed set-point (M) from og-01 reduced carbon

k_wash.description: CSTR washout / dilution rate (1/s); the feed-vs-washout axis of the gain phase map

config.title: Campaign II — the protometabolic network igniting

composites.name: thermophoretic_concentration
composites.description: A reusable thermophoretic-concentration module for the Baaske thermal trap. Module F = genuine FiPy finite-volume accumulation column: thermophoresis (Soret) + buoyant convection concentrate a dilute feed, enrichment exponential in pore length (>10^8 favorable, ~1 in controls). flow_velocity=0 / porosity=1 give the no-trap controls. Requires fipy.

flow_velocity.description: Buoyant convective flow in the pore (m/s); 0 = no-convection control

config.title: Campaign III — the thermal trap concentrates an individual

composites.name: mixed_amphiphile_protocell
composites.description: A reusable mixed-amphiphile protocell module (Module G). Coarse-grained vesicle self-assembly + permeability calibrated to Jordan 2019: mixed single-chain amphiphiles broaden the pH / salt / divalent stability window and form vesicles that retain chemistry while staying permeable to the gradient (individuality without isolation). mix_fraction≈0 / high salt / acidic pH give the controls. Coarse-grained reproduction (not wrapped MD).

mix_fraction.description: Co-surfactant fraction (0 = single fatty acid; higher = broader Jordan window)

config.title: Campaign IV — the protocell window broadens (mixed amphiphiles)

composites.name: bioenergetic_internalization
composites.description: A reusable bioenergetic-internalization module (Module H). An evolutionary control loop (replicator dynamics, Sojo-2014 leaky-membrane fitness) under a declining external gradient: as the geochemical pmf collapses, an efficient-pump population internalizes gradient generation and persists, while a weak-pump control collapses (the Sojo constraint). catalyst_efficiency sets the arm. Coarse-grained, deterministic reproduction (not wrapped ALife).

config.title: Campaign V — selection internalizes the gradient

composites.name: heredity_module_comparison
composites.description: A reusable heredity-module comparison (Module J). Genuine libRoadRunner quasispecies replicator (Eigen error threshold): a heredity module (RNA-like / peptide / low-fidelity / non-heritable) replicates a polymer with whole-sequence fidelity Q = fidelity^length; above the threshold the functional information is retained and inheritance pays, below it errors win. Compares modules head-to-head on lineage fitness. Requires tellurium/libroadrunner.

module.description: Heredity-module preset: rna-like | peptide | low-fidelity | non-heritable

config.title: Campaign VI — heredity above the error threshold

composites.name: heredity_lineage_comparison
composites.description: A reusable agent-based heredity-lineage comparison (Module K). Individuals carry a chemical phenotype inherited at fission into a real lineage tree, with a module-specific mechanism: template Eigen ratchet (Q=fidelity^length), compositional GARD split (length-independent, no template), a template-focused hybrid, or a severed non-heritable control. Emits population mean function, functional fraction, size, lineage depth and realized heritability. Reproduces the Eigen error catastrophe at the agent level AND shows compositional heredity escaping the length catastrophe — heredity need not presume a long high-fidelity template.

module.description: Heredity module: template | compositional | hybrid | non-heritable

config.title: Campaign VI — heredity as an inherited lineage

composites.name: off_gradient_persistence
composites.description: A reusable off-gradient-persistence module (Module M). A lineage's co-limited (Liebig-minimum) free-energy + resource budget under relaxing geological support (external gradient, mineral access, feed all declining over the run), with three toggleable innovations: internal energy conversion (has_pump), active resource import (has_importer) and information maintenance (has_heredity). Because the budget is co-limited the innovation set is irreducible — as support -> 0 only the full set keeps net budget above the survival floor, so a knockout sweep identifies {pump, importer, heredity} as the minimum robust set for autonomy. Coarse-grained, deterministic reproduction (not a wrapped ALife engine).

gradient_support.description: Starting external-gradient support, relaxed to 0 over the run (dimensionless, 0-1)

mineral_access.description: Starting mineral / FeS-catalyst access, relaxed to 0 (dimensionless, 0-1)

has_pump.description: Internal energy conversion innovation (1 present; 0 knockout)

has_heredity.description: Information-maintenance innovation; without it the machinery degrades (1 present; 0 knockout)

decline_rate.description: Support relaxation per step (1/s); support reaches 0 partway through the run

config.title: Campaign VIII — the survival frontier off the gradient

composites.name: cross_feeding_metacommunity
composites.description: A reusable cross-feeding metacommunity module (Module L). N connected compartments, each a coarse-grained capability vector over a protometabolic function set, evolving under cross-feeding (byproduct of one feeds the next capability in a neighbour), horizontal transfer, and parasite/cooperator roles. Connected heterogeneous populations develop capability redundancy (robustness) and a collective repertoire single compartments do not; the emergent set's overlap with the anaerobic H2/CO2/FeS LUCA reconstruction is reported as a far-end boundary, not a target. Coarse-grained, deterministic reproduction (not wrapped ALife).

exchange_rate.description: Cross-feeding strength (use isolated flag, not 0, to disable)

parasite_load.description: Fraction of compartments that drain neighbours

isolated.description: Isolated counterfactual arm: no cross-feeding/HGT/parasitism (use this, not exchange_rate=0)

config.title: Campaign VII — where cross-feeding robustness emerges

composites.name: reduced_nitrogen_reactor
composites.description: A reusable FeS-mediated reduced-nitrogen module. The real ReducedNitrogenProductionProcess reduces NO3-/NO2- to NH4+ on an Fe/Ni/S catalyst (H2-dependent, temperature-windowed), adds a minor abiotic N2-fixation source, and draws ammonium into amino-acid precursors by reductive amination at a rate set by the carbon-fixation demand. Tracks the C:N supply ratio (carbon demand / reduced-N production) to test whether reduced nitrogen keeps pace with reduced carbon. fes_activity=0 / h2=0 are the no-mineral / no-reductant controls.

no3_supply.description: Open-flow nitrate feed (M/s); sets the ceiling on sustained reduced-N production

fes_activity.description: Active Fe/Ni/S catalyst in [0,1] (0 = no-mineral control)

c_demand.description: Carbon-fixation demand pulling reduced N into precursors (mol/s)

n2.description: Dissolved N2 available for minor fixation (M)

loss_rate.description: Open-flow washout of NH4+/precursor (1/s); 0 = closed batch (conservation control)

config.title: Campaign I — does reduced N keep pace with carbon?
